bug_summary: assert/parse/parseAsync関数に誤って@__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__アノテーションが付与されており、これらの関数はバリデーション失敗時に例外を投げるという副作用が本質にもかかわらず、バンドラーのツリーシェイキングによって呼び出し自体が除去されバリデーションが黙って無効化されうる問題を修正。
pr_diff:
diff --git a/library/src/methods/assert/assert.ts b/library/src/methods/assert/assert.ts
index b1f5f975..4dfbb61f 100644
--- a/library/src/methods/assert/assert.ts
+++ b/library/src/methods/assert/assert.ts
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@ import { ValiError } from '../../utils/index.ts';
  * @param schema The schema to be used.
  * @param input The input to be tested.
  */
+// @__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__
 export function assert<
   const TSchema extends BaseSchema<unknown, unknown, BaseIssue<unknown>>,
 >(schema: TSchema, input: unknown): asserts input is InferInput<TSchema> {
diff --git a/library/src/methods/parse/parse.ts b/library/src/methods/parse/parse.ts
index 17e48864..2c2ce1c5 100644
--- a/library/src/methods/parse/parse.ts
+++ b/library/src/methods/parse/parse.ts
@@ -17,6 +17,7 @@ import { ValiError } from '../../utils/index.ts';
  *
  * @returns The parsed input.
  */
+// @__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__
 export function parse<
   const TSchema extends BaseSchema<unknown, unknown, BaseIssue<unknown>>,
 >(
diff --git a/library/src/methods/parse/parseAsync.ts b/library/src/methods/parse/parseAsync.ts
index 329fefad..09452865 100644
--- a/library/src/methods/parse/parseAsync.ts
+++ b/library/src/methods/parse/parseAsync.ts
@@ -18,6 +18,7 @@ import { ValiError } from '../../utils/index.ts';
  *
  * @returns The parsed input.
  */
+// @__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__
 export async function parseAsync<
   const TSchema extends
     | BaseSchema<unknown, unknown, BaseIssue<unknown>>
pr_description: Adds @__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__ annotations to assert, parse, and parseAsync so bundlers can tree-shake calls whose results go unused, matching the annotations already used elsewhere in the library's public API.
